tei:div.tei:p: 363)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: gro lod sgrub thabs byin rlabs mchog ster zab mo bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: sku gsum rigs 'dus he ru ka: che mchog rdo rje khro bo lod: de yi sgrub thabs zab mo ni: skal ldan bu yi don du bstan: sa ma ya: skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed ni: na mo: dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi dpal mchog: rig 'dzin bla mar skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro ba sems can kun: yang dag sar 'god sems bskyed do: lan gsum: dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni: āḥ 'khor 'das chos kun stong pa'i ngang: rang mdangs snying rje chen por shar: rig pa rgyu yig hūm̐ dmar nag: de las 'od 'phros rgyal kun mchod: byin rlabs tshur bsdus hūm̐ la thim: phyi snod pad+ma 'od kyi zhing: nang bcud dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dal: de dbus lhun grub gzhal yas khang: tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs klong: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng: rang nyid rdo rje gro bo lod: dmar smug mdangs ldan zhal gcig pa: spyan gsum sdang mig dbyings su gzigs: 364)am gtsigs mche ba rno dkar ldan: dbu skra dmar ser g.yas su 'khyil: thod skam dbu rgyan rtse bran mdzes: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu phyar: gnod byed rgyal gdon rdul du brlag: g.yon pas phur pa bgegs la gzir: log 'dren dam sri zil gyis gnon: sku la phod ka ber chen dang: thang sham bla gos chos gos gsol: thod rlon phreng bas do shal 'phyangs: zhabs gnyis dor stabs me dpung klong: stag mo grus ma'i steng na 'gying: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba'i zhing la phog: rgyal kun thugs rgyud ma lus bskul: rdo rje gro lod rnam par ru: spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med gyur: thugs kar rdo rje'i lte ba ru: hūm̐ yig dmar nag mtha' ma la: sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas su 'khor: 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur bsdus:

snang srid lha yi phyag rgyar smin: sgra grags sngags kyi 'khor lor dag: dran rtog mnyam nyid chos skur rdzogs: ma 'khrul ye yin chen po'i ngang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: de ltar 365)dmigs gnad ldan pa yis: bye ba bzlas pas 'grub par nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: skabs su phrin las rno so ni: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las: 'od zer lcags sdig nag po ni: mgo dgu lus po mig gis gang: kha rlangs na bun 'thib pa bzhin: me dpung mtshon cha tha ra ra: gnod byed rgyal 'gong dam sri kun: rdul brlag zas zos khyur mid btang: rjes shul lhag med bsregs par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru rak+sha gro bo lod sarba duṣ+ṭan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ma yengs ting 'dzin gsal pa'i ngang: bzlas pas rgyal gdon gnod mi tshugs: zab bo phyi rabs las 'phro can: rtags mtshan lag tu longs dang gsal: gcig brgyud gsang bar nyams su longs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: brda thim: srog gi spu gṛs gnyer gyis shig: dam nyams lag tu ma shor bar: thub par srungs shig ḍāk+ki'i rgya: ces pa'ang sprul pa'i sku mchog sa man+ta sur+ya'i bka' stsal spyi bor son tshe su kha badz+ra rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda las dag par bris pa'o// rjes su mchod bstod ni: chos dbyings ngang las sgyu ma'i 'phrul: phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab: 366)lhag pa'i lha la 'bul gyis bzhes: mchog tu mi 'gyur dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ=sogs: shap+da rū pa shap+da=sogs: sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling ta la kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung ye shes chen po'i rtsal: gdug pa 'dul mdzad he ru ka: che mchog rdo rje gro bo lod: rigs kun yongs 'dus khyod la bstod: su kha badz+ra gyis so// rgyun khyer tshogs mchod bsdus pa ni: āḥ pad+ma'i snod du thabs shes rdzas: tshogs kyi mchod pa bla na med:

nam mkha' mdzod kyis byin brlabs pas: dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ hrīḥ rang snang rnam dag pho brang nas: rigs kun khyab bdag he ru ka: rdo rje gro lod gtso 'khor 'das: gnas 'dir tshogs la gshegs su gsol: rin chen pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: blang dor med pa'i tshogs mchod 'bul: bde stong zhen med chen por bskangs: gnyis 'dzin bag chags dbyings su bshags: ma rig gnyis snang ru tra bsgral: bdag med chos sku'i klong du bstabs: tshims pa drug ldan dngos grub rol: a la 367)la ho: rtsal snang lhag mgron lhag la rol: rlung sems dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: sarba ma hā ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi: 'di la kun du brtson gyur na: rig 'dzin bla mas rjes bzung nas: tshogs gnyis 'bras bu myur thob nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa'ang mchog sprul dam pa'i bzhed skong du su kha badz+ra rtsal gyis so// bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ che ba'i che mchog pad+ma he ru kaḥ lha srin sde brgyad ma rungs 'dul mdzad pa: dregs pa zil gnon yi dam gro bo lod: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: ces dang bkra shis ci rigs brjod: 368)
